description: A marked function's own parameter defaults are enforced along with its body: the default runs on every call, so a throwing one breaks the mark's promise.

diagnostics.message: Call to `readFactor` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `readFactor` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
